rationale: Record a diagnostics-only change that crosses two families through their core/render/**, core/view/** and test/** selectors. The Dawn GpuSurface records per-stage startup timings and the macOS window host records bounded per-frame main-thread cost, and the standalone and headless screenshot paths log the chosen adapter, the startup timings and a frame-time summary at the end of a bounded run. New public headers (gpu_startup_report.hpp, host_frame_timing.hpp, detail/frame_time_summary.hpp) and tests in test_gpu_diagnostics.cpp, test_gpu_surface.cpp and test_screenshot_capture.cpp cover the formatting and the defaulted virtuals. No importer, DesignIR, capture path, renderer output, render asset, codegen output, visual fixture, threshold or Vellum-owned source changes, and no existing visual verdict changes. Registered as watch-only so the families' coverage stays honest about a change that crossed their selectors. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
